description.narrative: Global initiative to end all Corporal Punishment of Children works to prevent violence against children by promoting a Universal ban on all corporal punishment. The project conducts advocay work in relation to governments, UN and International NGO's.

"Global Initiative to end all Corporal Punishment of Children" är ett projekt som verkar för att skydda barn mot aga genom att främja staters antaganden av lagstiftning som förbjuder aga. Projektet bedriver påverkansarbete och samverkar med FN, NGO och stater.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Global initiative (GI) has been mapping states that have prohibited all corporal punishment against children. They have gathered information on states that have committed to law reform as well as carried out research which has resulted in an extensive online database. The database is a source of information and issues for advocacy purposes. The information collected has been used to influence states to end corporal punishment against children. The advocacy by GI, in collaboration with international and national organisations coupled with specific briefings to UN treaty bodies, have likely had an influential impact on the increase of states prohibiting or committing to the prohibition of corporal punishment against children. GI is a strong catalyst for change and its work has contributed to the prohibition of corporal punishment against children in numerous states. To date (2016) 50 (46 in 2015) states have prohibited corporal punishment against children, an increase from 2013 with a total of 11.
